About Jared Gibbons
Which areas of Surrey should I look at for houses?

Surrey breaks down into main pockets: South Surrey, Clayton, Sullivan Heights, Panorama Ridge, Newton, Guildford, Fleetwood and Cloverdale. Lot sizes, home ages and price points differ in each, so I pick the area that suits your budget and commute.
What schools serve Surrey?
These homes fall in Surrey School District 36. Since catchments follow the address, check the exact school with the district before buying.
How is transit and commuting from Surrey?
Getting around, you have RapidBus R1/R6, the SkyTrain Expo Line running from King George to Scott Road, and the Surrey Langley SkyTrain that is coming along Fraser Hwy.
What zoning rules affect houses in Surrey?

Under the new Surrey Zoning Bylaw, the R-zones will absorb RF/RF-13/RF-10, which is what most detached lots are zoned today. Separately, Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit housing means many lots can hold as many as 3-4 units.
What should I check before buying a detached house in Surrey?
Freehold title, no strata fees, and room for a suite or garden. I review documents with you before subjects are removed.
Are first-time buyer exemptions available in Surrey?
Yes, if you qualify, you can use the federal FHSA together with property transfer tax relief under the BC First-Time Home Buyers' program. Current thresholds are in my first-time buyer guide.
